svg.aria-label: Animated illustration of a skateboarder riding a halfpipe at dusk, launching above the coping and grabbing the board
svg.title: VERT — one full period of a halfpipe run, solved with g = 9.81 m/s2
svg.desc: Side cutaway of a halfpipe at dusk. A helmeted skater crosses the flat bottom, compresses at the bottom of the transition, launches vertically above the coping, grabs the board at the apex where velocity reaches zero, and drops back in. Scale 150 px per metre.

g.text: TRANSITION R 1.60 m · DECK 1.73 m · PERIOD 4.00 s
